files.purpose: Project build configuration with all dependencies and scripts for dev, build, test, and coverage
files.content:
{
  "name": "tictactoe",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "vite build",
    "preview": "vite preview",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "coverage": "vitest run --coverage"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@reduxjs/toolkit": "^2.2.1",
    "react": "^18.2.0",
    "react-dom": "^18.2.0",
    "react-redux": "^9.1.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@testing-library/jest-dom": "^6.4.2",
    "@testing-library/react": "^15.0.2",
    "@testing-library/user-event": "^14.5.2",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^4.2.1",
    "@vitest/coverage-v8": "^1.4.0",
    "eslint": "^8.57.0",
    "eslint-plugin-react": "^7.34.1",
    "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "^4.6.0",
    "jsdom": "^24.0.0",
    "prettier": "^3.2.5",
    "vite": "^5.2.0",
    "vitest": "^1.4.0"
  }
}

files.purpose: Shared constants for winning lines, symbols, game modes, and game status values
Pure function module that evaluates board state and returns WIN, DRAW, or IN_PROGRESS with winner info
Minimax algorithm implementation for unbeatable CPU play returning optimal cell index
Redux Toolkit slice managing all game state including board, turns, status, mode, and scoreboard
Redux store configuration combining gameSlice reducer with optional localStorage persistence middleware
Custom React hook encapsulating all game interaction logic including move validation, win detection, and CPU scheduling
Single cell component rendering X, O, or empty state with click prevention for occupied cells
3x3 grid component rendering nine Cell components and dispatching click events via useGameState hook
Displays current game state: active turn, win announcement, or draw declaration from Redux store
Game start screen allowing players to choose between Local PvP and Vs CPU modes
Reset button that clears board cells and restores turn to X without modifying scoreboard counters
Displays persistent session-level win/draw counters for X wins, O wins, and draws from Redux store
Root component composing all game components and conditionally rendering mode selection vs active game board
Application entry point rendering App component wrapped in Redux Provider
HTML entry point for the single-page application
Unit tests for winDetection module covering all win lines, draw detection, and in-progress states
Unit tests for minimax algorithm verifying CPU never loses and always picks optimal moves
Integration tests for ModeSelector component verifying mode dispatch and rendering
Integration tests for Board component verifying cell rendering and click interactions
